text: {"assertions":["On 2026-02-17, a memory blowup issue was discovered in graph/store/adjacency.rs affecting records with non-ASCII names.","Resident memory in the adjacency store was climbing with every batch processed.","The root cause was an error being swallowed by a bare except clause.","The fix involved narrowing the exception handler to allow the failure to propagate, submitted as PR #2151 on branch fix/memory-blowup-1.","The issue could be reproduced by loading the dense neighbourhood fixture.","A flaky module test in graph/store/adjacency.rs improved from 38 failures per 100 runs to zero after the fix."]}
